title: Real media evidence and hash-bound owner preview approval

root_cause.finding: The active A7 media adapters are intentionally fail-closed NoopMediaRenderer and NoopMediaVerifier. No configured real renderer, verifier, existing A10 packet, or locally reviewable media asset exists. The current Windows environment exposes only claude.cmd/claude.ps1, while the frozen A4 adapter requires a native claude.exe and explicitly rejects a cmd shim.
root_cause.why_not_a_test_problem: Architecture v3.0 section 17 forbids text tests from claiming visual acceptance. A non-empty JSON object, a fixture, or a generated placeholder cannot replace a real media run, frame evidence, a same-scene v4/vNext comparison, or the owner's independent decision.
root_cause.why_not_self_repaired: A10 may write only its tests, operations protocol, A10 run directory, and A10 evidence. It may not modify the A7-owned media adapter implementation, the A0-owned release controller, v4, a FeatureGate, or release-state fields directly. Replacing a Noop adapter or accepting a cmd shim inside A10 would violate exclusive task ownership and the frozen native-Windows transport invariant.

observations.name: native_claude_transport
observations.result: No claude.exe is resolvable. The available Claude Code installation is version 2.1.214 through claude.cmd/claude.ps1, which the v3.0 structured adapter rejects by design on Windows.

observations.name: media_adapter_boundary
observations.result: NoopMediaRenderer and NoopMediaVerifier raise unavailable errors rather than fabricate a provider result or frame evidence.

observations.name: media_asset_preflight
observations.result: No A10 release-run directory, MEDIA_VISUAL_ACCEPTANCE packet, or locally reviewable image/video asset was found in the project workspace.

observations.name: production_boundary
observations.result: production_entry remains v4_unchanged and production_switch_authorized remains false; no external media, v4 mutation, owner approval, or production switch was performed.

repair_delivered_within_a10_scope: An A10 operations protocol that requires local physical media/frame files, SHA256 verification, same-scene v4/vNext attribution, rollback evidence, and independent owner approval.

A registered A10 readiness test that rejects controller-minimum JSON, validates actual external evidence when present, and emits an auditable skip rather than a false pass when no external packet exists.

verification_results.name: a10_media_release_readiness
verification_results.result: 1 passed, 1 skipped. The skip is an auditable external-media-absent condition and is not a media-acceptance claim.

verification_results.name: a7_fail_closed_media_boundary
verification_results.result: 20 passed; the registered A7 boundary continues to reject fabricated renderer/verifier outcomes.

verification_results.name: a10_v4_entrypoint
verification_results.result: 15 passed; v4 remains the active production entrypoint.

verification_results.name: release_ledger_audit
verification_results.result: ok=true before fail-close; no architecture or ledger drift was introduced.

required_external_or_replanned_work: Provision an actual media renderer and verifier capable of producing and preserving v4 and vNext same-scene runs, or authorize a new architecture-controlled ownership change that activates such an adapter and invalidates affected downstream evidence.
Provision the frozen native Windows text transport required for a fresh vNext raw-source-to-Projection run; do not use a cmd/PowerShell shim as a substitute.
After a genuine A10 media packet exists, the project owner must independently inspect it and personally create the hash-bound OWNER_PREVIEW_APPROVAL.
